title: Projector not turning on
description: The projector in room 204 does not power on. The light on it stays red and we have a lecture at 2 pm.

title: Wi-Fi very slow in the library
description: The campus Wi-Fi on the first floor of the library keeps disconnecting every few minutes. Cannot download papers.

title: Ceiling fan making noise
description: Fan number 3 in classroom 105 makes a loud grinding sound and wobbles at high speed.

title: Washroom tap leaking
description: The tap in the ground floor boys washroom has been leaking all night. Water is collecting on the floor.

title: Sparks from switch board
description: When I switched on the lights in lab 3 there were sparks from the board and a burning smell. Nobody is using the room now.

title: Broken chairs in seminar hall
description: About five chairs in the last row of the seminar hall have broken armrests. Students cannot sit on them.

title: Garbage not cleared
description: The dustbins on the second floor corridor have not been emptied for three days and there is a bad smell.

title: Mic in auditorium cuts out
description: The cordless mic in the auditorium keeps cutting out during talks. We have a guest lecture tomorrow.

title: LAN port not working
description: The network port at desk 14 in the computer lab gives no connection. Other desks are fine.

title: Water flooding near lift
description: A pipe seems to have burst near the lift on the ground floor. Water is spreading into the corridor fast.

title: Tube light flickering
description: One of the tube lights in the reading room flickers constantly and gives a headache.

title: Mess food quality
description: The dinner in the hostel mess has been cold and undercooked for the past week.

title: Geyser not heating
description: The geyser in the third floor bathroom gives only cold water since Monday.

title: Smart board frozen
description: The interactive smart board in classroom 301 is stuck on the start screen and does not respond to touch.

title: Toilet flush broken
description: The flush in the second cubicle of the staff washroom does not work at all.

title: Desk top is loose
description: The top of the desk at the front of lab 2 is coming off its frame. Minor, but it shakes when we write.

title: Router lights blinking red
description: The router in the department office has a blinking red light and nobody on this floor can get online.

title: Cockroaches in the pantry
description: There are cockroaches in the staff pantry cupboards. Please arrange pest control.

title: AC not cooling
description: The air conditioner in the conference room runs but blows warm air.

title: Speakers buzzing
description: The ceiling speakers in lecture hall 2 make a constant buzzing noise even when nothing is connected.

title: Laundry machine out of order
description: Both washing machines in the hostel laundry room show an error and do not start.

title: Bench in courtyard broken
description: One of the stone benches in the courtyard has a cracked seat and a sharp edge.

title: No water in the hostel
description: There has been no water supply on the fourth floor since morning. Taps are dry.

title: Smoke from the projector
description: Smoke started coming out of the projector during class and it shut down. We unplugged it.

title: Classroom not cleaned
description: Room 112 has paper and food wrappers all over the floor from yesterday. It was not swept today.

title: Power socket dead
description: None of the plug points along the window wall of lab 5 work, so laptops cannot be charged.

title: Notice board glass cracked
description: The glass on the notice board outside the principal's office is cracked.

title: Cannot log in to campus Wi-Fi
description: My laptop connects but the login page never loads, so I have no internet in my room.
